reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the already-selected needs by descending demand_score and record_id, preserving record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank. For the assigned output, this matches the two handoffs n06-r07 then n06-r08.

select_demand hard-codes fallback_ids n06-r07 and n06-r08 and selects them even though they are the lowest demand_score records in the supplied corpus. Under the strict market-demand criteria, this is behaviorally significant: the selected demand is not supported by the strongest observed demand signals and drives the downstream recommendation toward an unsupported low-demand item.

normalize_evidence only normalizes columns, types, allowed record ids, and bounded row count for the selected records. The evidence supplied does not show it changing demand ordering or introducing the low-demand selection defect.
